name: IEC / manufacturer defaults
description: Default rule-layer thresholds for the ensemble demo. Sources: HI-105 section 6 (transformer top-oil ceiling), DAR-141 research + IEC 61215 / IEC 61730 / UL 61730 (PV hot-spot dT tiers). To supply utility-specific SCADA setpoints, copy this file, edit the numbers, and pass it with --thresholds <path>.

camera.description: Placeholder 8-bit pixel -> degC map used by the demo (pixel 0 = 20 degC, 255 = 120 degC). Images are min-max stretched per image first, so these are not real temperatures. Real radiometric extraction is HER-81; once a camera reports degC directly these become unused.

transformer.description: Top-oil ceiling: ambient + 85 degC (HI-105 section 6). Greenville summer ambient assumed.

pv.description: PV hot-spot dT tiers (DAR-141 research). 8-bit PV imagery cannot give absolute cell degC, so the rule layer uses a contrast proxy: (percentile - mean) scaled into the dT tier range. It measures pixel contrast, not degrees, so the tiers are not validated dT limits.
